mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notif_group_subscriptions (uuid, group_uuid, notification_type, channel_key, created_at) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{groupUuid}, #{notificationType}, #{channelKey}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT uuid, group_uuid, notification_type, channel_key, created_at FROM notif_group_subscriptions
mapper.select: SELECT g.name AS group_name, ngs.notification_type FROM notif_group_subscriptions ngs INNER JOIN groups g ON ngs.group_uuid = g.uuid INNER JOIN groups_users gu ON ngs.group_uuid = gu.group_uuid WHERE gu.user_uuid = #{userUuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY g.name ASC, ngs.notification_type ASC
